complementary: two hues opposite on the wheel — high contrast, vibrant.

dialogs.tour.edit.body: Pick a photo in the filmstrip or the grid, then edit with the tools here; each opens its own panel. Click the photo for 100%, press \ for before. ⌘Z undoes.
dialogs.tour.adjust.title: Adjustments
dialogs.tour.adjust.body: The familiar develop panels. Drag a slider or scroll over it; double-click resets it.
dialogs.tour.crop.title: Crop
dialogs.tour.crop.body: Aspect ratios, straighten and rotate. R opens it, Enter applies.
dialogs.tour.masks.title: Masks
dialogs.tour.masks.body: Brush, gradients, ranges and AI selections: adjust just one part.
dialogs.tour.heal.title: Heal
dialogs.tour.heal.body: Click a spot or paint over a line to remove it. Q opens it.
dialogs.tour.zones.title: Zone System
dialogs.tour.zones.body: Black and white tones as zones 0–X: see where each falls, then place or adjust it.
dialogs.tour.film.title: Film Simulation
dialogs.tour.film.body: Render the photo as a film, developed and printed or scanned, from measured film and paper data.
dialogs.tour.negative.title: Negative
dialogs.tour.negative.body: Turn a photo of a film negative into a positive, picked from its border.
dialogs.tour.presets.title: Presets
dialogs.tour.presets.body: Live previews of presets and film looks; save your own.
dialogs.tour.advanced.title: Advanced modules
dialogs.tour.advanced.body: The stacked-cards button at the top of Adjustments switches to darktable's modules. Click it again to return to Simple; your photo and edits stay the same.
dialogs.tour.sendOut.title: Send photos out
dialogs.tour.sendOut.body: Export or print the photo when you are done with it.
dialogs.tour.export.title: Export
dialogs.tour.export.body: To a folder or an Immich album, with borders and file names of your choosing. ⇧⌘E.
dialogs.tour.print.title: Print
dialogs.tour.print.body: Print, or save a PDF. Soft proof (S) shows the print on screen first. ⌘P.
dialogs.tour.preferences.title: Preferences
dialogs.tour.preferences.body: What new photos start with (profile and a preset), and your Immich server. ⌘, opens them.
